subject: General Knowledge
description: First Indian to … (Olympic medal, Mt Everest, space, Nobel, etc.) — niche under-asked angles

questions.stem: The first Indian to fly in space (1984) was:

options.option_text: Rakesh Sharma — flew aboard Soyuz T-11 to Salyut 7

questions.explanation: Rakesh Sharma — IAF Wing Commander; flew on Soyuz T-11 (3-11 April 1984) to Salyut 7 with Yuri Malyshev + Gennady Strekalov. India's 1st cosmonaut. Spent ~7 days 21 hours in orbit. Famously replied 'Sare Jahan Se Achha' to PM Indira Gandhi's question on how India looked from space. Awarded Hero of Soviet Union. Backup pilot was Ravish Malhotra. Kalpana Chawla — first Indian-origin AMERICAN astronaut (1997, Columbia mission STS-87 + STS-107 where she perished, 2003). Sunita Williams — Indian-origin American astronaut (2006, ISS).

questions.stem: The first Indian to win an INDIVIDUAL Olympic gold medal (in any discipline) was:

options.option_text: Abhinav Bindra — 10 m air rifle, Beijing 2008

questions.explanation: Abhinav Bindra — 10 m air rifle gold at Beijing 2008 — first individual Olympic gold for India. Earlier: India had won field hockey TEAM golds (8 times: 1928, 32, 36, 48, 52, 56, 64, 80). K.D. Jadhav — first individual MEDAL (bronze, wrestling, Helsinki 1952), not gold. Norman Pritchard — earlier 'Indian' Olympic medallist 1900 (2 silvers, athletics) — but a British colonial. Neeraj Chopra — javelin gold at Tokyo 2020 (held 2021), India's 2nd individual Olympic gold + first in athletics.

questions.stem: The first Indian woman to summit Mount Everest (1984) was:
questions.explanation: Bachendri Pal — climbed Everest on 23 May 1984, age 30 — first Indian woman summiteer. From Nakuri, Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand. Padma Shri 1984; Padma Bhushan 2019. First Indian to summit Everest — Tenzing Norgay (jointly with Edmund Hillary, 29 May 1953 — though Tenzing was Indian-Nepali). Subsequent Indian women — Santosh Yadav (1992 + 1993, first to summit twice), Premlata Agarwal (oldest Indian woman, 2011 at age 48), Arunima Sinha (first amputee, 2013), Anshu Jamsenpa (twice in 5 days, 2017).

questions.stem: The first Indian-born scientist to win the Nobel Prize (in Physics, 1930) was:

options.option_text: C.V. Raman — for the 'Raman Effect' (light scattering)

questions.explanation: Sir C.V. Raman — Nobel Physics 1930 — for discovery of the 'Raman Effect' (28 February 1928, observed at IACS, Calcutta). When light passes through transparent material, a small fraction is scattered with shifted frequency due to vibrational/rotational energy of molecules. Foundation of Raman spectroscopy. India observes 28 Feb as National Science Day. Other Indian / Indian-origin Nobel laureates: Tagore (Lit, 1913), C.V. Raman (Phys, 1930), Hargobind Khorana (Med, 1968 — naturalised American), S. Chandrasekhar (Phys, 1983, naturalised American), Mother Teresa (Peace, 1979), Amartya Sen (Econ, 1998), Venki Ramakrishnan (Chem, 2009, naturalised British), Kailash Satyarthi (Peace, 2014), Abhijit Banerjee (Econ, 2019, naturalised American).

questions.stem: The first Field Marshal of the Indian Army was:

options.option_text: Sam Manekshaw — promoted in 1973 after the 1971 Bangladesh War victory

questions.explanation: Sam Hormusji Framji Jamshedji Manekshaw 'Sam Bahadur' (Parsi) — appointed Field Marshal on 1 January 1973 — first FM of Indian Army. Architect of 1971 Bangladesh war victory in 13 days. K.M. Cariappa — second FM (1986, granted retrospectively as part of CAS recognition), India's first Indian COAS (1949). Field Marshal is a 5-star rank — never retires (technically 'on duty' till death). India has had only 2 FMs ever. Air-equivalent — Marshal of the Air Force: Arjan Singh (2002).

questions.stem: The first PERMANENT MEMBER of the Indian Supreme Court was:

options.option_text: H.J. Kania — became the first Chief Justice of independent India in 1950

questions.explanation: Hiralal Jekisundas Kania (1890-1951) — first CJI of independent India (28 Jan 1950 till death on 6 Nov 1951). Sworn in by President Rajendra Prasad. Pre-1950 CJIs of the Federal Court: Maurice Gwyer, Sir Patrick Spens. Post-1950 CJIs known by tenure: M. Patanjali Sastri (2nd), Mehrchand Mahajan (3rd), B.K. Mukherjea (4th), S.R. Das (5th), B.P. Sinha (6th). M. Hidayatullah (1968-70) — also acted as President. Justice Y.V. Chandrachud — longest-serving CJI (Feb 1978 - July 1985). Justice D.Y. Chandrachud — 50th CJI (2022-24).

questions.stem: The first Indian woman President was:
questions.explanation: Pratibha Patil — 12th President of India (25 July 2007 - 24 July 2012). First woman President. Earlier: Governor of Rajasthan; AICC member; longtime Maharashtra politician. Indira Gandhi was the first WOMAN PM (3 terms — 1966-77, 1980-84). Droupadi Murmu — 15th President (2022-27) — first tribal woman President. Other firsts: Sucheta Kripalani — first woman CM (UP, 1963); Indira Gandhi — first woman PM; M. Fathima Beevi — first woman SC judge (1989); Pratibha Patil — first woman President. India is yet to have a woman as VP, CJI, COAS or RBI Governor.
